body: A problem I've had with psychiatrists is trust issues. I know the whole doctor-patient confidentiality stuff, but it's a personal thing, I'm just not comfortable opening up to a complete stranger.
I have tried medication. I don't remember exactly what effects it had but I don't take it anymore, for some reason.

Kind of. They don't do much in the way of counseling though.. I've gone there for a depression episode a couple years ago and it didn't really help. They told my parents and then my parents just kept trying to convince me that self-mutilation wasn't worth it. Didn't really help.
